## Importando pacotes e dados
```{r echo = T, message = F, warning = F}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
# 1. Importando pacotes
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
library(dplyr)         # For data manipulation (e.g., mutate, filter)
library(ggplot2)       # For creating plots
library(marginaleffects) # For calculating and plotting marginal effects and predictions
library(glmmTMB)       # For fitting Generalized Linear Mixed Models
library(DHARMa)        # For model diagnostics using simulated residuals
library(patchwork)     # For combining multiple ggplot objects into a single plot
library(performance)   # For model diagnostics
library(sf)            # For handling spatial data
library(GGally)
library(MASS)
library(kableExtra)
library(mgcv)
library(mgcViz)
```

## Análise exploratória dos dados
```{r echo = T}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#   Análise exploratória
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
grafico <- function(data = env_total, var, title, xlab, ylab, color = "black") {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = data[,var])) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "lightblue", color = color) +
  labs(title = title,
       x = xlab,
       y = ylab) +
  theme_minimal()
}

g1 <- grafico(var = "NATU_PCT", title = "Natural land cover (%)", xlab = "Natural land cover (%)", ylab = "Frequency")
g2 <- grafico(var = "attr_inter", title = "Intermitencia", xlab = "Intermitencia", ylab = "Frequency")
g3 <- grafico(var = "nimp_median", title = "Nº Impacts", xlab = "Nº Impacts", ylab = "Frequency")
m_cor <- ggpairs(env_total,         
        columns = c("NATU_PCT", "attr_inter", "nimp_median", "nimp_high","nimp_low","impact"),
        lower = list(continuous = "smooth")) # Columns

plot(g1 / g2 / g3)
m_cor

```

## Modelagem dados de contagem
```{r echo = T}
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#         Modelos
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
env_total[,c("attr_inter", "nimp_median", "nimp_low", "nimp_high", "NATU_PCT","x","y","impact")] <- scale(env_total[,c("attr_inter", "nimp_median", "nimp_low", "nimp_high", "NATU_PCT","x","y","impact")])
env_total$cd_site <- as.factor(env_total$cd_site)

#Modelo de Poisson
m_poisson <- glmmTMB(Richness ~ NATU_PCT * attr_inter,
              data = env_total, family = poisson(link = "log")
)

# Model diagnostics and summary.
x2 <- sum(residuals(m_poisson, type = "pearson")^2)
rdf <- df.residual(m_poisson)
dispersion <- x2/rdf
dispersion

# Modelo binomial negativa
m_nb <- glmmTMB(Richness ~ NATU_PCT * attr_inter,
              data = env_total, family = nbinom2(link = "log")
)

# Model diagnostics and summary.
x2 <- sum(residuals(m_nb, type = "pearson")^2)
rdf <- df.residual(m_nb)
dispersion <- x2/rdf
dispersion

residuos <- simulateResiduals(m_nb, plot = TRUE)
acf(residuals(m_nb))
testSpatialAutocorrelation(residuos, x = env_total$x, y = env_total$y)

# Modelo GAM com binomial negativa + spatial
m_nb_gam <- gam(Richness ~ impact * attr_inter + s(x, y),
              data = env_total, family = nb(link = "log")
)

# Model diagnostics and summary.
x2 <- sum(residuals(m_nb_gam, type = "pearson")^2)
rdf <- df.residual(m_nb_gam)
dispersion <- x2/rdf
dispersion

residuos <- simulateResiduals(m_nb_gam, plot = TRUE)
acf(residuals(m_nb_gam))
testSpatialAutocorrelation(residuos, x = env_total$x, y = env_total$y)
summary(m_nb_gam)

# Gráficos
b <- getViz(m_nb_gam)
gam_rich <- plot(sm(b, 1)) + l_fitRaster() + l_fitContour() + l_points()


# Predições
quantis_attr <- quantile(env_total$attr_inter, probs = c(0.25, 0.75))
df_per <- data.frame(impact = seq(min(env_total$impact), max(env_total$impact), length.out = 545),
                     attr_inter = quantis_attr[1],
                     y = mean(env_total$y),
                     x = mean(env_total$x))
df_int <- data.frame(impact = seq(min(env_total$impact), max(env_total$impact), length.out = 545),
                     attr_inter = quantis_attr[2],
                     y = mean(env_total$y),
                     x = mean(env_total$x))

pred <- function(model){



  pred_per <- predict(model, newdata = df_per, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE)
  pred_int <- predict(model, newdata = df_int, type = "response", se.fit = TRUE)

  df_per$fit <- pred_per$fit
  df_per$se <- pred_per$se.fit
  df_per$lower <- df_per$fit - 1.96 * df_per$se
  df_per$upper <- df_per$fit + 1.96 * df_per$se
  df_per$Type <- "Perennial"

  df_int$fit <- pred_int$fit
  df_int$se <- pred_int$se.fit
  df_int$lower <- df_int$fit - 1.96 * df_int$se
  df_int$upper <- df_int$fit + 1.96 * df_int$se
  df_int$Type <- "Intermittent"

  df <- rbind(df_per, df_int)
  return(df)
}

df <- pred(m_nb_gam)

# Gráfico efeito interação
ggplot(df, aes(x = impact, y = fit, color = Type)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(y = "Richness",
       x = "Impacto") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Modelo Gamma 
```{r echo = T}
# Modelo Gama
m_gama <- glmmTMB(Fric_effect ~ impact * attr_inter,
                 data = env_total, 
                 family = Gamma(link = "log")
)

# Model diagnostics and summary.
residuos <- simulateResiduals(m_gama, plot = TRUE)
acf(residuals(m_gama))
testSpatialAutocorrelation(residuos, x = env_total$x, y = env_total$y)

# GAM + spatial
m_gama_gam <- gam(Fric_effect ~ impact * attr_inter + s(x,y),
                 data = env_total, 
                 family = tw(link = "log")
)

# Model diagnostics and summary.
residuos <- simulateResiduals(m_gama_gam, plot = TRUE)
acf(residuals(m_gama_gam))
testSpatialAutocorrelation(residuos, x = env_total$x, y = env_total$y)
summary(m_gama_gam)


b <- getViz(m_gama_gam)
gam_rich <- plot(sm(b, 1)) + l_fitRaster() + l_fitContour() + l_points()

df <- pred(m_gama_gam)

# Gráfico efeito interação
ggplot(df, aes(x = impact, y = fit, color = Type)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(y = "Fric_effect",
       x = "Impacto") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Modelo Beta 
```{r echo = T}
# Beta effect
m_beta <- glmmTMB(FRedundancy_effect ~ impact * attr_inter,
                 data = env_total, 
                 family = beta_family(link = "logit")
)

residuos <- simulateResiduals(m_beta, plot = TRUE)
testSpatialAutocorrelation(residuos, x = env_total$x, y = env_total$y)
acf(residuals(m_beta))
summary(m_beta)


#beta gam
m_beta_gam_fe <- gam(FRedundancy_effect ~ impact * attr_inter + s(x, y),
                 data = env_total,
                 family = betar(link = "logit")
)

residuos <- simulateResiduals(m_beta_gam_fe, plot = TRUE)
acf(residuals(m_beta_gam_fe))
testSpatialAutocorrelation(residuos, x = env_total$x, y = env_total$y)
summary(m_beta_gam_fe)

b <- getViz(m_beta_gam_fe)
gam_rich <- plot(sm(b, 1)) + l_fitRaster() + l_fitContour() + l_points()

AIC(m_beta_gam_fe, m_beta)

df <- pred(m_beta_gam_fe)

# Gráfico efeito interação
ggplot(df, aes(x = impact, y = fit, color = Type)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(y = "FRic_response",
       x = "Impacto") +
  theme_minimal()
```
